summary: Sub-phase 15.3 STEP 6c is complete: the nested eventuality-aware liveness fixpoint (fwdLiveT / bwdLiveT / liveT) and the generic round-robin concatenation, with one fair walk per live position. STEP 6d stops at a condition-set question -- LabRun.coherent's box clause is supplied by nothing in the condition set -- raised as a non-blocking user decision with a recommendation.

artifacts.summary: Round-4 summary extended with dispatch 33: STEP 6c complete (Glue, Fair, LiveFix.lean), plus the two corrections it recorded and the STEP 6d blocker.
Resume point: STEP 6d's box-clause blocker with both candidate resolutions and a recommendation, the other three 6d pieces named, and 17 environment hazards.

blockers.verbatim_goal: A forward walk and a backward walk agreeing at one vertex splice at position level into a LabRun, whose five fields are exactly the eight readouts 6b landed.
blockers.what_was_tried: Enumerated every Prop-valued certificate condition in the subtree (BiSerial, BiSerialWindow, BoxFaithful, Target, plus AgreesOnState and the two Fold relations) and checked each against PlusLocalCoherentSeqLab's five clauses. Four of LabRun's five fields do come straight off Unroll.lean's readouts.
blockers.why_it_failed: LabRun.coherent demands PlusLocalCoherentSeqLab, whose box clause is `PlusFormula.box chi in lab t iff G.bx chi = true`. Position.lean's LabCoherent deliberately omits it; AgreesOnState only gives `box chi in lab t iff box chi in G.slab t (st t)`; and (C3) BoxFaithful relates G.bx chi to `forall t w, chi in G.slab t w` -- the SUBFORMULA chi, not the boxed formula box chi. No condition supplies `box chi in G.slab t w iff G.bx chi = true`, and mem_posAt_of_path runs the other way, dropping the clause on the way in. Closing it is a condition-set decision, not proof work.

user_decision.question: STEP 6d cannot build a LabRun until something supplies PlusLocalCoherentSeqLab's box clause, `PlusFormula.box chi in lab t iff G.bx chi = true`. No clause in the sliced certificate's condition set does: (C3) BoxFaithful constrains the subformula chi, not the boxed formula box chi. How should that gap be closed?
options: (a) Add a (C3b) box-label clause to the condition set -- `forall chi, box chi in plusClosureOf (Gamma ++ Del) -> forall t w, (box chi in G.slab t w iff G.bx chi = true)` -- and thread it as a hypothesis through 6d's LabRun construction; decided on the window by exists_window_eq exactly as BoxFaithful is.

(b) Fold the box clause into Position.lean's LabCoherent, so posAt membership carries it, accepting that AgreesOnState then silently forces the same constraint on the certificate and that succP / predP / verts / mem_posAt_of_path are perturbed.
user_decision.recommended: (a) Add a (C3b) box-label clause to the condition set -- `forall chi, box chi in plusClosureOf (Gamma ++ Del) -> forall t w, (box chi in G.slab t w iff G.bx chi = true)` -- and thread it as a hypothesis through 6d's LabRun construction; decided on the window by exists_window_eq exactly as BoxFaithful is.
